title: Extras Taken Together on a Snowsports School Booking
content:
Extras taken together cost less than extras taken one at a time, so the lift access add-on raised on a Snowsports School booking is allowed points of its own. The allowance is judged by the add-on entries already standing against that booking.

Where two or more add-on entries already stand against the booking, the full bundle points are allowed, and they stand at 10 points. Where exactly one add-on entry already stands against it, the part bundle points are allowed, and they stand at 5 points. Where no add-on entry stands against it, no bundle points are allowed, and the allowance stands at 0 points.

## Entries standing and points allowed

| Add-on entries already standing against the booking | Points allowed |
| --- | --- |
| 2 or more | 10 |
| exactly 2 | 10 |
| exactly 1 | 5 |
| none | 0 |

The entries counted are those already standing on that booking's school account on the handling date, of whatever kind of add-on; entries standing against another booking of the same household account are not counted.

## What the points do

These points are a reduction in percentage points on the lift access add-on for a Snowsports School booking. They are combined with the other reductions allowed on that add-on into one total in percentage points, and the add-on figure is reduced once by that total rather than by each reduction in turn.

## Illustrations

- A booking against which a rental add-on entry and a lunch add-on entry already stand is allowed 10 points; on a lift access add-on of 200.00 USD those points are worth 20.00 USD.
- A booking against which a single add-on entry already stands is allowed 5 points, worth 10.00 USD on that same add-on figure.
- A booking against which nothing has yet been raised as an add-on is allowed nothing on this count, and its lift access add-on is not reduced on this count at all.
